$comment: QR-18: each crate's floor for line and region coverage of the native test run, as `cargo xtask coverage` measures it (one `cargo llvm-cov --workspace` run; every workspace test counts toward every crate). A floor starts at the first measured value rounded down and only goes up: a measurement under it fails, and so does a floor more than headroomPoints below it, so the PR that earned the coverage raises the floor (`cargo xtask coverage --update` only raises). Lowering a floor is a hand edit with its reason here.

bindings/native-fixture.reason: a minimal binary that exists so the hardening and reproducibility gates have a subject; it has no tests and nothing to cover

bindings/wasm.reason: first measured 2026-11-08 at 66.25% lines and 60.04% regions; the per-module test exports (edge_router, coincident_ends) are exercised by the wasm differentials, not natively. Raised to 74 lines and 68 regions when tests/survivors_budget_write_back.rs reached the budget write-back: 75.70% lines locally, 69.80% regions on CI. Raised to 82 lines and 77 regions with the OKF exports, replayed natively from okf.jsonl (tests/okf_oracle.rs) beside the exports' own tests: 82.97% lines and 77.43% regions locally. Raised to 87 lines and 82 regions with the JSON Canvas exports and their canvas wire, replayed from json-canvas.jsonl (tests/json_canvas_oracle.rs) beside the exports' and the wire's own tests: 87.99% lines and 82.47% regions, measured both locally and on CI (an earlier local reading of 89.57% and 84.13% was not reproduced, and set the floor above what the tests reach). Raised to 88 lines and 84 regions with the facet write export, replayed from facet-write.jsonl (tests/facet_write_oracle.rs) beside its own tests: 89.84% lines and 85.14% regions locally, measured over this crate's tests alone (the workspace run adds none to it). Raised to 91 lines with the font registry (spatial_layout/fonts), whose register, layout-over-handle and release paths are tested natively: 91.16% lines on CI; regions stay at 84, inside their headroom. Raised to 87 regions with the markdown entry (spatial_layout/markdown, its request and its tests) and its native replay of the layout-markdown recordings (tests/markdown_oracle.rs): 87.09% regions locally

core/markdown.reason: measured 2026-11-12 by `cargo xtask coverage` (one `cargo llvm-cov --workspace` run, counted per crate): 96.77% lines and 96.12% regions, then 96.78% and 96.13%, with the recorded mdast oracle replayed (every difference but the ledgered ones failing), the alignment regressions, the second autolink pass's tests, the dialect examples, the OKF corpus, the fixed token corpus, the limits, the cost shapes and the totality property. The hundredth of a point between runs is under the floor's rounding. Before the oracle replay the crate stood at 92.56% lines and 92.27% regions. What is left is the vendored code no test text reaches: the tree builder's arms for an event stream the tokenizer does not produce (a node pushed under a non-parent, a stray exit), the constructs' refusals of syntax no corpus writes, and the arms of the upstream state machine for an HTML or footnote shape the examples do not spell
